BFD_PROFILE_SBFD_ECHO_VALID.desc: A BFD_PROFILE in sbfd_echo mode with an SRv6 source_ipv6 is accepted.

BFD_PROFILE_MODE_INVALID.desc: An unknown mode enum value must be rejected.

BFD_PROFILE_SOURCE_IPV6_INVALID.desc: A malformed source_ipv6 must be rejected by the inet:ipv6-address type.

BFD_PROFILE_SOURCE_IPV6_WITHOUT_SBFD.desc: source_ipv6 is out of scope (when) unless mode is sbfd_echo.

BFD_PROFILE_NAME_WITH_QUOTE.desc: Profile name containing a single quote must be rejected by the name pattern; otherwise it would mis-parse in vtysh command construction.

BFD_PROFILE_NAME_WITH_SPACE.desc: Profile name containing whitespace must be rejected by the name pattern; FRR does not accept whitespace in profile names.

BFD_PROFILE_ASYNC_TIMERS_1000_VALID.desc: An async (mode bfd) profile with 1000ms receive/transmit intervals is accepted.

BFD_PROFILE_ASYNC_RECEIVE_INTERVAL_NOT_S.desc: An async (mode bfd) profile receive_interval other than 100 or 1000 ms must be rejected; hardware BFD offload only supports these timer values.
eStr: must be 100 or 1000 ms when hardware BFD offload

BFD_PROFILE_ASYNC_TRANSMIT_INTERVAL_NOT_.desc: An async profile (mode defaulted to bfd) transmit_interval other than 100 or 1000 ms must be rejected; the must guard sees the mode default.
eStr: must be 100 or 1000 ms when hardware BFD offload

BFD_PROFILE_SBFD_ECHO_TIMER_NOT_SUPPORTE.desc: An sbfd_echo profile timer other than 100 or 1000 ms must also be rejected; the 100/1000 restriction applies to all modes (hardware BFD offload).
eStr: must be 100 or 1000 ms when hardware BFD offload

BFD_PROFILE_RECEIVE_INTERVAL_TOO_LOW.desc: receive_interval below 10ms must be rejected (FRR floor is 10ms per frr-bfdd.yang range "10000..max" microseconds).

BFD_PROFILE_DETECT_MULTIPLIER_TOO_LOW.desc: detect_multiplier below 2 must be rejected (BFD requires at least 2 to tolerate a single packet loss).

BFD_PROFILE_BIND_VALID.desc: BGP_NEIGHBOR.bfd_profile referencing an existing BFD_PROFILE entry is accepted by the leafref.

BFD_PROFILE_BIND_GHOST_REJECTED.desc: BGP_NEIGHBOR.bfd_profile referencing a non-existent BFD_PROFILE entry must be rejected by the leafref. This is the symmetric protection for delete-while-bound: any final state in which a peer references a missing profile is invalid, regardless of how it was reached.

BFD_PROFILE_BIND_VALID_PEER_GROUP.desc: BGP_PEER_GROUP.bfd_profile referencing an existing BFD_PROFILE entry is accepted by the leafref. The bfd_profile leaf lives in the shared sonic-bgp-cmn grouping; both BGP_NEIGHBOR_LIST and BGP_PEER_GROUP_LIST inherit it, so the leafref must work on either.

BFD_PROFILE_BIND_GHOST_REJECTED_PEER_GRO.desc: BGP_PEER_GROUP.bfd_profile referencing a non-existent BFD_PROFILE entry must be rejected by the leafref — the same symmetric protection as the BGP_NEIGHBOR case.

BFD_PROFILE_BIND_VALID_TEMPLATE.desc: BGP_NEIGHBOR_TEMPLATE_LIST.bfd_profile referencing an existing BFD_PROFILE entry is accepted by the leafref. This is the bgpcfgd-mode (default) BGP neighbor table written by GCU and nhcli; the bgpd/templates/*/instance.conf.j2 templates already render bfd / bfd profile <name> from this table, so the YANG must surface the same leaves.

BFD_PROFILE_BIND_GHOST_REJECTED_TEMPLATE.desc: BGP_NEIGHBOR_TEMPLATE_LIST.bfd_profile referencing a non-existent BFD_PROFILE entry must be rejected by the leafref — same symmetric protection as the BGP_NEIGHBOR / BGP_PEER_GROUP cases.

BFD_PROFILE_NO_HW_OFFLOAD_TIMERS_UNRESTR.desc: Without hardware BFD offload (NPU switch) the 100/1000 ms restriction does not apply; 300 ms is accepted (software BFD keeps the full range).

BFD_PROFILE_SOFTWARE_BFD_OVERRIDE_UNREST.desc: On a VOQ switch with hw_bfd_offload enabled but software_bfd forced, sessions run in software and timers are unrestricted.

BFD_PEER_SINGLE_HOP_VALID.desc: Load valid standalone single-hop BFD peers: one with 'null' local-address and full session fields, one on a PortChannel with an explicit local-address and echo fields

BFD_PEER_SINGLE_HOP_NULL_INTERFACE_REJEC.desc: Single-hop peer with 'null' interface must be rejected (frrcfgd always emits 'interface <name>')

BFD_PEER_SINGLE_HOP_DUPLICATE_TRIPLE_REJ.desc: Two single-hop peers sharing remote-address/interface/vrf and differing only in local-address must be rejected: FRR keys single-hop sessions on the triple, so both rows would drive one session

BFD_PEER_MULTI_HOP_VALID.desc: Load valid standalone multihop BFD peers: same remote/local across several VRFs plus the default VRF (NOS-14139 repro), and an IPv6 peer

BFD_PEER_MULTI_HOP_INTERFACE_REJECTED.desc: Multihop peer with a real interface must be rejected (FRR prohibits interface with multihop)

BFD_PEER_MULTI_HOP_FAMILY_MISMATCH_REJEC.desc: Multihop peer with IPv4 remote-address and IPv6 local-address must be rejected

BFD_PEER_VRF_WITHOUT_PREFIX_REJECTED.desc: Peer vrf without the Vrf prefix (and not default/mgmt) must be rejected — only coverage of the new bfd-vrf-name typedef

BFD_PEER_HW_OFFLOAD_TIMER_NOT_SUPPORTED.desc: With hardware BFD offload (VOQ switch) a 300 ms peer timer must be rejected
eStr: must be 100 or 1000 ms when hardware BFD offload

BFD_PEER_NO_HW_OFFLOAD_TIMERS_UNRESTRICT.desc: Without hardware BFD offload (NPU switch) the 100/1000 ms restriction does not apply; 300 ms is accepted

BFD_PEER_SINGLE_HOP_PORT_MISSING_REJECTE.desc: Reject a single-hop peer on a port missing from PORT

BFD_PEER_SINGLE_HOP_INTERNAL_PORT_REJECT.desc: Reject a single-hop peer on an internal port, even one in PORT
eStr: An internal port cannot carry a BFD session

BFD_PEER_SINGLE_HOP_VLAN.desc: Configure a single-hop peer on an existing VLAN

BFD_PEER_SINGLE_HOP_VLAN_MISSING_REJECTE.desc: Reject a single-hop peer on a VLAN missing from VLAN
